prompt: Vertical 9:16 large-format documentary photograph, 4x5 view camera, deep focus, cool overcast daylight from high clerestory windows. A clean industrial money printing press sits inside a sealed glass room in an empty concrete hall, running on its own: a neat stack of notes grows on the output tray. No operator. The control desk outside the glass has no buttons, only one mechanical counter and a small engraved brass plaque reading "NO HUMAN HANDS". An office chair has been pushed away and left facing the wall. Dust in the air, a scuffed floor line, faint fingerprints on the glass. Thanks.
